name: GLX equity-perp product
tagline: Cash-settled, no-expiry perps on US stocks, 1 share per contract
summary: The contract every Greyline/GLX model shared: a Security Futures Product on single US stocks and SPY/QQQ, 23×5 hours, hourly pure-premium funding, square-root margin and a flat 2/5 bps (retail) and 0/2 bps (market maker) fee. A 500 ms Backstop Liquidity Provider auction ported from MIAX PRIME replaced ADL from January to April 2026, then was dropped for on-book liquidation in May.

name: GLX regulatory pathway and fee exemption
tagline: Two SFP asks plus a fee reset make 1-share perps legal
summary: Classify equity perps as Security Futures Products and ask for two things: replace the 15% customer-margin floor with √Q margin (SEC §36 + CFTC 41.42(d)) and confirm funding satisfies 'future delivery' (CFTC §4(c)(1)(B) + SEC interpretation). Recalibrate the SEC §31, NFA and FINRA fees that would cost $221B/yr at $1Q down to $400M; tax as §1234B security futures with an open §871(m) question.
